name: Feature request
about: An idea to make Nyx better
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem / motivation

What are you trying to do that Nyx doesn't support well (or at all)?

## Proposed solution

How should it work from the user's side? Screenshots or rough mockups
welcome.

## Alternatives considered

Other ways to solve the same problem, and why they're worse.

## Which layer?

- UI/design (components, tokens)
- Stellar logic (lib/stellar)
- Planned phase (bills / anchors — see docs/roadmap.md)
- Tooling/CI/docs

## Contribution

Are you willing to implement this? (No pressure either way — well-scoped
ones may also be added to docs/backlog.md for other contributors.)
